story_plan.thesis: Election scenario preview: distinguish the expected Democratic sweep from alternative congressional outcomes and a delayed count, explaining conditional reactions across bonds/rates, major FX, commodities, US equity indices, US equity sectors and Bitcoin. Polling describes voting intentions, not control probabilities or election results; market scenarios remain conditional, with no position calls.

visual_review.inspection_method: Local view_image, detail original, of the exact 1600 x 960 r2 PNG; compared with its exact sibling JSON and frozen source/PREVIEW.md.
visual_review.source_findings: Democrats 51.1% and Republicans 42.8% match the PollCheck figures attributed in the approved PREVIEW and sibling data JSON. The subtitle accurately says updated 2 November 2026. First polls close at 23:00 UTC on 3 November matches the PREVIEW timing attributed to 270toWin. visual_review.meaning_findings: The two parties have separate equal-status numerical callouts. The card explicitly labels the figures as voting intentions, not chamber-control probabilities. It makes no result claim and does not promise that chamber control will be known at first poll close. As a fact card it has no plotted axis or proportional area; an axis baseline is not applicable.
visual_review.layout_findings: Title, party labels, percent signs, date, meaning note, poll-close footer and source credit are legible against the light background. Adequate margins and separation; no clipping, overlap, hidden labels or mismatched associations seen in the inspected original. Same restrained colour treatment for both values. The r2 on-image source credit contains PollCheck and 270toWin attribution without workflow wording.
